cards.gloss_en: a soft, thick, moist mixture like wet clay
cards.ex_en: She mixed flour and water into a soft paste.
cards.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水和成软糊。

cards.gloss_en: coated with a shiny glass-like surface
cards.ex_en: The potter glazed the bowl to make it shiny.
cards.ex_cn: 陶工给碗上釉,让它发亮。

cards.gloss_en: a heavy tool for crushing things in a bowl
cards.ex_en: He crushed the seeds with a pestle.
cards.ex_cn: 他用研杵把种子捣碎。

cards.gloss_en: an old word for a fine sieve
cards.ex_en: She sifted the flour through a searce.
cards.ex_cn: 她用细筛把面粉筛过。

cards.gloss_en: imagining or picturing something in the mind
cards.ex_en: He kept fancying he would soon be rich.
cards.ex_cn: 他老是幻想自己很快会发财。

cards.gloss_en: logs or rods used to roll a heavy load along
cards.ex_en: They moved the heavy boat on wooden rollers.
cards.ex_cn: 他们用木滚轴移动那条重船。

cards.gloss_en: people born in a certain land
cards.ex_en: The natives showed us the way to the river.
cards.ex_cn: 当地人给我们指了去河边的路。

cards.gloss_en: a tall evergreen tree with fragrant wood
cards.ex_en: The chest was made of sweet-smelling cedar.
cards.ex_cn: 这只箱子是用香雪松做的。

cards.gloss_en: started or taken on a task or duty
cards.ex_en: She has undertaken a very hard task.
cards.ex_cn: 她着手做了一件很难的任务。

cards.gloss_en: trouble or difficulty that causes discomfort
cards.ex_en: The broken lift caused us great inconvenience.
cards.ex_cn: 电梯坏了给我们带来很大不便。

cards.gloss_en: a man-made channel for carrying water
cards.ex_en: Boats float slowly along the old canal.
cards.ex_cn: 小船沿着旧运河缓缓漂行。

cards.gloss_en: strong bodily or greedy desires
cards.ex_en: He gave up the lusts of a greedy life.
cards.ex_cn: 他放弃了贪婪生活的种种欲望。

cards.gloss_en: a gross, i.e. 144 items; also coarse
cards.ex_en: The dirty room smelled quite gross.
cards.ex_cn: 那间脏屋子闻起来很恶心。

cards.gloss_en: covered with mould from damp
cards.ex_en: The old bread had gone mouldy.
cards.ex_cn: 那块旧面包发霉了。

cards.gloss_en: to strip the skin off an animal
cards.ex_en: The hunter began to flay the dead deer.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人开始给死鹿剥皮。

cards.gloss_en: earned or was worthy of by one's actions
cards.ex_en: He worked hard and deserved the prize.
cards.ex_cn: 他很努力,理应得到这个奖。

cards.gloss_en: taught or told what to do
cards.ex_en: The teacher instructed us to stay quiet.
cards.ex_cn: 老师叮嘱我们保持安静。

cards.gloss_en: things that cause great fear or dread
cards.ex_en: The dark forest was full of hidden terrors.
cards.ex_cn: 黑暗的森林里满是隐藏的恐怖。

cards.gloss_en: rescues from danger or trouble
cards.ex_en: He thanked God for so many deliverances.
cards.ex_cn: 他为这么多次脱险而感谢上帝。

cards.gloss_en: great wickedness or unfairness
cards.ex_en: He was ashamed of his past iniquity.
cards.ex_cn: 他为过去的罪恶感到羞愧。

cards.gloss_en: full of poison, able to give a poisonous bite
cards.ex_en: A venomous snake hid under the rock.
cards.ex_cn: 一条毒蛇藏在石头下面。

cards.gloss_en: comfort given in sadness or loss
cards.ex_en: Her kind words were a real consolation to me.
cards.ex_cn: 她温柔的话对我是真正的安慰。

cards.gloss_en: sleeveless garments worn over a shirt
cards.ex_en: He wore two warm waistcoats in winter.
cards.ex_cn: 冬天他穿了两件暖和的马甲。

cards.gloss_en: someone who makes or mends clothes
cards.ex_en: The tailor made me a new coat.
cards.ex_cn: 裁缝给我做了一件新外套。

cards.gloss_en: accepting something calmly without resisting
cards.ex_en: He found peace by resigning himself to the loss.
cards.ex_cn: 他顺从地接受损失,心里平静了。

cards.gloss_en: friendly and enjoying the company of others
cards.ex_en: She is friendly and very sociable.
cards.ex_cn: 她友善,又很好交际。

cards.gloss_en: able to be done or carried out
cards.ex_en: The plan was simple and quite practicable.
cards.ex_cn: 这个计划简单而且完全可行。

cards.gloss_en: supplied with food for a journey
cards.ex_en: They victualled the ship before the long voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在远航前给船备足了粮食。

cards.gloss_en: dirty, muddy, or unpleasant
cards.ex_en: The air in the cave was thick and foul.
cards.ex_cn: 洞里的空气又浓又污浊。

cards.gloss_en: moving a boat with a paddle
cards.ex_en: The boy was paddling the canoe across the lake.
cards.ex_cn: 男孩正划着独木舟横渡湖面。

cards.gloss_en: deep holes dug in the ground
cards.ex_en: He dug deep pits to catch the wild goats.
cards.ex_cn: 他挖了几个深坑来捕野山羊。

cards.gloss_en: surrounding with a fence or wall
cards.ex_en: He built a fence, enclosing the small field.
cards.ex_cn: 他建了道篱笆,把小田圈了起来。

cards.gloss_en: drew milk from an animal
cards.ex_en: She milked the goat every morning.
cards.ex_cn: 她每天早上给山羊挤奶。

cards.gloss_en: ate a main meal
cards.ex_en: We dined together by the warm fire.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在暖火旁一起用餐。

cards.gloss_en: a kind or group of similar living things
cards.ex_en: This island has many rare species of birds.
cards.ex_cn: 这座岛上有许多稀有的鸟类物种。

cards.gloss_en: buried in the ground
cards.ex_en: The old cat was interred beneath the tree.
cards.ex_cn: 那只老猫被埋在树下。

cards.gloss_en: existing in large amounts
cards.ex_en: Fish were plentiful in the clear river.
cards.ex_cn: 清澈的河里鱼很丰富。

cards.gloss_en: a long, wandering walk for pleasure
cards.ex_en: We went for a long ramble in the hills.
cards.ex_cn: 我们去山里长长地漫步了一回。

cards.gloss_en: a cord or string used to tie something
cards.ex_en: He tied his boots with a leather lace.
cards.ex_cn: 他用皮带子系好靴子。

cards.gloss_en: to give proof or evidence of something
cards.ex_en: These marks testify that he worked hard.
cards.ex_cn: 这些痕迹证明他很努力。

cards.gloss_en: mainly, for the most part
cards.ex_en: He lived principally on fish and fruit.
cards.ex_cn: 他主要靠鱼和水果为生。

cards.gloss_en: giving good nutrition to the body
cards.ex_en: Warm soup is very nourishing in winter.
cards.ex_cn: 热汤在冬天很滋补。

cards.gloss_en: a pattern of alternating light and dark parts
cards.ex_en: Life is a strange chequer of good and bad.
cards.ex_cn: 人生是好坏交错的奇怪格局。

cards.gloss_en: thoughts that guess about uncertain things
cards.ex_en: His mind was full of curious speculations.
cards.ex_cn: 他脑中满是种种好奇的推测。

cards.gloss_en: having unlimited power
cards.ex_en: They believed in an omnipotent God.
cards.ex_cn: 他们相信一位全能的上帝。

cards.gloss_en: made or became thicker
cards.ex_en: He thickened the wall with more stones.
cards.ex_cn: 他又加石头把墙加厚了。

cards.gloss_en: the act of carrying or moving something
cards.ex_en: The carriage of the earth took many days.
cards.ex_cn: 搬运泥土花了好多天。

cards.gloss_en: units of land area
cards.ex_en: He planted corn on three acres of land.
cards.ex_cn: 他在三英亩地上种了玉米。

cards.gloss_en: cruel, savage behaviour
cards.ex_en: The war was fought with great brutality.
cards.ex_cn: 这场战争打得极其残暴。

cards.gloss_en: a fall into low or corrupt behaviour
cards.ex_en: He was shocked by their degeneracy.
cards.ex_cn: 他们的堕落令他震惊。

cards.gloss_en: a state of confusion and lack of order
cards.ex_en: The room was left in complete disorder.
cards.ex_cn: 房间被弄得一片混乱。

cards.gloss_cn: 可鄙的、卑劣的;(也)可怜的、悲惨的
cards.gloss_en: contemptible or vile; also miserable
cards.ex_en: The wretched dog was cold and hungry.
cards.ex_cn: 那只可怜的狗又冷又饿。

suspect.ctx: I would have given a h[andful of it for a gross of tobacco-pipes]
suspect.issue: 书中"a gross of tobacco-pipes"是数量单位"一罗(12打=144个)",此处gross作名词,现释义"粗劣的/令人厌恶的"(形容词)回读不通
suspect.suggest: 补名词义项"罗(计数单位,一罗=144个)"

suspect.ctx: an abhorrence of the savage wretches...and of the wretched, inhuman custom of their devouring
suspect.issue: 此处"the wretched, inhuman custom"修饰吃人习俗,意为"可鄙的、恶劣的",非"可怜的/悲惨的";回读语气相反(厌恶而非同情)
suspect.suggest: 补义项"(行为/习俗)可鄙的、卑劣的、恶劣的"
